## Summary

Describe clearly what was added or corrected.

## Type of content change

- [ ] New topic
- [ ] Conceptual correction
- [ ] Formula/equation correction
- [ ] Cheat-sheet update
- [ ] Review-page update
- [ ] References update

## Accuracy and quality checklist

- [ ] I explained what changed and why.
- [ ] Technical content is accurate to the best of my knowledge.
- [ ] Formulas/equations were verified.
- [ ] References are included for non-trivial claims.
- [ ] Formatting and links render correctly in MkDocs.
- [ ] I checked for duplicated content with existing notes.
- [ ] If status is `reviewed`, the content has been cross-checked.
